reading.title: Digital media vs traditional media
paragraphs: For many years, people got their news from traditional media such as newspapers, radio and television. These sources were usually credible because journalists fact-checked every story before it was broadcast or printed. However, traditional media was so slow that readers often learned about events a day after they happened. By contrast, digital media gives us instant and interactive news. A story can spread so quickly on social networks that millions of people read it within minutes.

Digital media is also more accessible: anyone with a phone can read, watch or share the news anywhere. Meanwhile, this freedom has created a serious problem. Fake news is such a big issue that many people no longer know which sources to trust. Some websites publish stories as if they were facts, although nobody has checked them. In my view, we should enjoy the speed of digital media, but we must read as carefully as a journalist does and always check the source.

theory.label: Cần nhớ
theory.content: Cách thức: {k as, as if / as though} (không có thật → quá khứ đơn, {k were}). Kết quả: {k so … that}, {k such … that}.
Unit 7 nói về truyền thông đại chúng.

theory.title: Mệnh đề chỉ cách thức
theory.text: Cho biết một việc được làm như thế nào, bắt đầu bằng as (như), as if / as though (như thể). Sau as if / as though, nếu điều không có thật ở hiện tại thì dùng quá khứ đơn (were cho mọi ngôi).
formulas: S + V + {c as if / as though} + S + V (quá khứ đơn nếu không có thật)

examples.en: Do {c as} the journalist does: check every source.
examples.vi: Hãy làm như nhà báo: kiểm tra mọi nguồn tin.

examples.en: He talks {c as if} he {k knew} everything about the news.
examples.vi: Anh ấy nói như thể biết hết mọi tin tức.

examples.en: She looks {c as though} she {k were} a famous TV presenter.
examples.vi: Cô ấy trông như thể là một người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng.

theory.wrong: She looks as though she was a famous TV presenter.
theory.right: She looks as though she {k were} a famous TV presenter.
theory.why: Điều không có thật ở hiện tại: dùng were cho mọi ngôi.

theory.title: Mệnh đề chỉ kết quả
theory.text: Cho biết hệ quả của một việc, dùng so … that hoặc such … that.
formulas: {c such} + (a/an) + adj + N + {c that} + S + V

examples.en: The news spread {c so quickly that} everyone knew about it.
examples.vi: Tin tức lan nhanh đến mức ai cũng biết.

examples.en: It was {c such an interesting programme that} I watched it twice.
examples.vi: Đó là một chương trình thú vị đến mức tôi xem hai lần.

examples.en: There were {c so many adverts that} I turned off the TV.
examples.vi: Có quá nhiều quảng cáo nên tôi tắt ti vi.

theory.tip: so đi với tính từ / trạng từ; such đi với cụm danh từ. Có thể bỏ that trong văn nói.

try.q: It was ___ a long film that we left early.

theory.title: Phát âm: nối âm /r/
theory.text: Nối âm /r/ giữa hai nguyên âm (linking /r/).

items.stem: The story spread ____ fast that everyone knew it within an hour.
It was ____ an interesting documentary that we watched it twice.

wrong_explain.1: So không đứng trước cụm danh từ có mạo từ.

items.stem: He talks ____ he were a famous journalist.
items.explain: As if + quá khứ đơn: như thể.

wrong_explain.3: Such không mở đầu mệnh đề.

items.stem: Từ nào có nghĩa là "tin giả"?
Always check the ____ before you share a story online.
There were ____ adverts during the film that I stopped watching.
items.explain: So many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều + that.

wrong_explain.1: As if là như thể, không hợp nghĩa.

choices: The news was so shocking that nobody believed it.
The news was such shocking that nobody believed it.
The news was so shocking news that nobody believed it.
The news was shocking so that nobody believed it.

wrong_explain.2: So không đi với cụm danh từ.

items.stem: Digital news is more ____ than newspapers because you can read it anywhere.
She behaves as though she ____ the owner of the TV station.
items.explain: As though + điều không có thật: quá khứ đơn, were.

wrong_explain.1: Điều không có thật dùng quá khứ.
wrong_explain.2: Không dùng hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.stem: Social media ____ a large proportion of young people's free time.
Theo đoạn văn, vì sao truyền thông truyền thống thường đáng tin cậy?
items.explain: Journalists fact-checked every story before it was broadcast or printed.

wrong_explain.3: Interactive là đặc điểm của báo số.

items.stem: According to the writer, what should we do with digital news?
choices: Read carefully and check the source.
items.explain: We must read as carefully as a journalist does and always check the source.

wrong_explain.1: Tác giả nói nên tận hưởng tốc độ của báo số.

items.stem: Câu nào ĐÚNG theo đoạn văn?
choices: Fake news makes it hard to know which sources to trust.
Traditional media was faster than digital media.
Digital media is less accessible than newspapers.
Nobody reads news on social networks.
items.explain: Fake news is such a big issue that many people no longer know which sources to trust.

items.stem: Nối hai câu: "The advert was very funny. Everyone remembered it."
choices: The advert was so funny that everyone remembered it.
The advert was such funny that everyone remembered it.
The advert was so funny advert that everyone remembered it.
The advert was funny as if everyone remembered it.

wrong_explain.2: Thừa danh từ sau so funny.

items.stem: Chọn từ phù hợp: "Newspapers are printed and ____ to shops early in the morning."

wrong_explain.2: Spread là lan truyền, không hợp với to shops.

items.stem: Tìm lỗi sai: "The programme was such (A) popular that (B) the station broadcast (C) it again as (D) viewers requested."
items.explain: Popular là tính từ nên dùng so popular.

items.stem: Chọn câu có nghĩa gần nhất: "He writes as if he had seen the accident himself, but he wasn't there."
choices: He writes like an eyewitness although he did not see the accident.
He saw the accident and wrote about it.
He was at the accident but did not write about it.
He refused to write about the accident.
items.explain: As if + quá khứ hoàn thành: điều không có thật trong quá khứ.

writing.prompt: Viết 6–8 câu so sánh báo in/truyền hình với mạng xã hội trong việc đưa tin. Dùng ít nhất một câu so ... that hoặc such ... that và một câu có as if / as though hoặc as.
checklist: Câu đầu nêu hai loại truyền thông em so sánh.
Có ít nhất một câu so ... that hoặc such ... that.
Có một câu dùng as, as if hoặc as though.
Nêu một ưu điểm và một nhược điểm của mạng xã hội.
Mỗi câu viết hoa chữ đầu và có dấu chấm cuối câu.
sample: Today many young people get the news from social media instead of newspapers or TV. Social media is so fast that we can learn about an event within minutes. It is also interactive, so we can comment and share.

However, fake news spreads so quickly that many people believe it. Some posts are written as if they were facts, but nobody has checked them. In my opinion, we should read online news as carefully as a journalist does.
